title: KOL (influencer) management company — front account (demo script)
summary: Synthetic training case. A company that claims to run KOL (influencer) management has no brand contracts. Yet its account receives personal credits that look like shopping, investment and romance fraud stories, and the money is sent out quickly. A related synthetic company has similar flows. The trainee decides whether to run enhanced due diligence (EDD), draft a suspicious transaction report, recommend a freeze, or exit. The credits must not be recorded as brand cooperation. Inspired by public summaries of KOL management front companies. It is not a real customer file.

teaching.disclaimer: Synthetic training scenario inspired by public enforcement reporting. Not official case files; no real customer data.

sources.label: Public enforcement briefing on KOL management company accounts (URL not in the course brief)

rules.when: The claimed KOL management business has no contracts or staff records, and the credits come from retail third parties
rules.note: Do not record the credits as brand cooperation when there is no contract. Rules come before any model score.

rules.when: The stories behind the credits mix phone, investment or romance fraud patterns, and the money is sent out quickly
rules.note: Do not relabel these credits as brand cooperation and then close the case.

nodes.title: KOL management company review
nodes.prompt: Synthetic KOL Management Company A says it runs KOL management. Its account receives many personal credits. There are no brand contracts and no staff payroll records. The related Synthetic KOL Management Company B has similar flows.

nodes.title: Check the business claim?
nodes.prompt: Both contracts and payroll are missing. Do you run enhanced due diligence on the business, exit the relationship, or record the credits as brand cooperation for now?

choices.label: Request the management contracts and run EDD
choices.rationale: Get business evidence first, then let R1 decide.

choices.label: Exit the customer relationship
choices.rationale: Retail credits with no contract are already enough to exit.

choices.label: Record as brand cooperation
choices.rationale: Teaching override. The booking label does not change the fact that there is no contract.

nodes.title: No management contract produced
nodes.prompt: The customer cannot produce a management contract. The credit remarks look like shopping, investment and romance fraud stories, not brand cooperation. Rule R1: a front like this requires enhanced due diligence or an exit.

nodes.title: Exits under the front-company rule
nodes.prompt: R1 has fired. Do you hold outbound payments, draft a suspicious transaction report now, or accept the oral business explanation?

choices.label: Hold outbound payments and continue EDD
choices.rationale: Matches R1. First see whether the money is sent out quickly.

choices.label: Draft a suspicious transaction report
choices.rationale: No contract, plus retail third-party credits. You can report.

choices.label: Accept the oral explanation and release
choices.rationale: Overrides R1. The fraud-story types will still trigger the next rule.

nodes.title: Three fraud stories and rapid outflow
nodes.prompt: Further checks match three patterns: phone, investment and romance fraud. The money is sent out quickly. Rule R2: do not relabel these credits as brand cooperation.

nodes.title: How to record mixed proceeds
nodes.prompt: R2 has fired. Do you recommend a freeze and report, exit the relationship, or keep the brand-cooperation booking?

choices.label: Recommend a freeze and draft a suspicious transaction report
Keep the brand-cooperation label and close
choices.rationale: Poor teaching path. The rule already says the case must not be closed this way.

nodes.title: Suspicious transaction report drafted
nodes.prompt: Reporting exit. The synthetic IDs of Company A and related Company B stay in the state.

nodes.title: Freeze recommended and report drafted
nodes.prompt: Outbound payments are on hold. The report is drafted. If the brand-cooperation booking override happened, its flag remains.

nodes.title: Customer relationship exited
nodes.prompt: The relationship has ended. The no-contract and mixed-fraud-story flags stay in the twin state.

nodes.title: Closed as brand cooperation
nodes.prompt: Poor teaching path. R2 was ignored. The dashboard should later mark this session as not following the rules.
